title: Golden Irish Skillet Hash
description: A vegan twist on a traditional Irish dish, this skillet hash is made with tender potatoes and a hint of yellowed Irish goodness.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Add the vegan butter and allow it to melt.
Add the diced Irish potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the saffron threads over the potatoes and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and golden brown.
